original.target_description: Kim and Radoias (2016), IFLS hypertension under-diagnosis and disease management probit models, aggregate and good/poor general-health samples; intended outcome, sample and regressor unspecified.

notes: Assigned original fields only. Input has study_o=null, description=null, empty locators_o and es_type_o=null; the reference identifies the paper but no target coefficient, outcome or health subgroup. Primary title verified. Tables 2 and 4 each report six marginal effects in three samples; no unique row/test can be selected. Table 2: outcome hypertension under-diagnosis; aggregate/good-health/poor-health model Ns printed as 4209/3145/1064. Table 4: outcome good disease management (blood pressure checked at least once in preceding month); aggregate/good-health/poor-health model Ns printed as 1696/1100/596. N roles are hypertensive adult respondents, not observations or clusters. The disease-management sample is restricted to previously diagnosed respondents; the under-diagnosis sample includes hypertensive adults over 45 in 2007. Further missing-data exclusions are not established. No N sum calculated. Candidate Ns are retained only for field-scope review and are not assigned to this row. Candidate focal marginal effects in aggregate/good-health/poor-health order: Table 2 Years of Education -0.00333*, -0.00295, -0.00867**; Time Preference 0.03457***, 0.02763**, 0.03429. Table 4 Years of Education 0.00816***, 0.00625**, 0.01407***; Time Preference -0.3689**, -0.03214*, -0.03576. The Table 4 aggregate time-preference value is printed -0.3689 (confirmed visually), retained without correction. Other candidate regressors in both tables are Log PCE, Risk Preference, Distance to Health Center and Female. A further education model without risk/time preferences is discussed on p.19 with a reduction of 0.00354. The tables explicitly identify the metric as marginal effects, with standard errors in parentheses. Stars denote significance at 10%, 5%, 1% levels for *, **, *** respectively; exact p values are not given in these tables. No star-derived p bound is assigned without a target. Canonical text uses U+0002 in place of printed minus signs; PDF pp.5-7 (article pp.19-21) rendered and inspected for table layout/signs. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders; no replication source inspected.
